module agents.page_title
  purpose: Agent tools for reading web page titles.

import std.http as web

public type PageTitleError is one of
  purpose: Why a web page title could not be counted.
  NoTitle(url: web.Url)
end

public function title_length_in(page: Text)
  returns maybe Integer
  purpose: Count the characters inside the first title element in a page.
  example: title_length_in(page: "<html><head><title>Hello</title></head></html>") is some(5)
  example: title_length_in(page: "<html><head></head></html>") is nothing

  let lower_page be page.to_lower()
  let open_index be lower_page.index_of("<title>") otherwise return nothing
  let after_open be open_index + "<title>".length()
  let after_title_start be page.drop(after_open)
  let lower_after_title_start be lower_page.drop(after_open)
  let close_index be lower_after_title_start.index_of("</title>") otherwise return nothing
  let title_text be after_title_start.take(close_index)
  return title_text.length()
end

public function count_title_characters(url: web.Url)
  returns Integer
  or fails with PageTitleError
  needs network.http
  purpose: Download a web page and return the number of characters in its title element.
  expose as tool

  let page be web.get(url) otherwise fail
  let title_length be title_length_in(page: page) otherwise fail with NoTitle(url: url)
  return title_length
end

module agent_tools.title_length
  purpose: Count web page title characters for agents.

import std.http as web

public type PageTitleError is one of
  purpose: Why the page title length could not be read.
  DownloadFailed(url: web.Url)
  MissingTitle(url: web.Url)
end

function text_after(text: Text, marker: Text) returns maybe Text
  purpose: Return the text after the first marker.
  example: text_after(text: "a<title>Hello", marker: "<title>") is some("Hello")

  let position be text.index_of(marker) otherwise return nothing
  let start be position + marker.length
  return text.drop(start)
end

function text_before(text: Text, marker: Text) returns maybe Text
  purpose: Return the text before the first marker.
  example: text_before(text: "Hello</title>after", marker: "</title>") is some("Hello")

  let position be text.index_of(marker) otherwise return nothing
  return text.take(position)
end

function title_text(page: Text) returns maybe Text
  purpose: Return the text inside the page title element.
  example: title_text(page: "<html><title>Hello</title></html>") is some("Hello")

  let lower_page be page.to_lower()
  let after_open_lower be text_after(text: lower_page, marker: "<title>") otherwise return nothing
  let title_start be lower_page.length - after_open_lower.length
  let after_open_original be page.drop(title_start)
  return text_before(text: after_open_original, marker: "</title>")
end

public function title_length(url: web.Url)
  returns Integer
  or fails with PageTitleError
  needs network.http
  purpose: Download a web page and return the number of characters in its title element.
  expose as tool

  let page be web.get(url) otherwise fail with DownloadFailed(url: url)
  let title be title_text(page) otherwise fail with MissingTitle(url: url)
  return title.length
end

module web_title_tool
  purpose: Agent tool for counting characters in a web page title.

import std.http as web

public type TitleLengthError is one of
  purpose: Why a page title length could not be read.
  DownloadFailed(url: web.Url)
  MissingTitle
end

public function title_character_count(url: web.Url)
  returns Integer
  or fails with TitleLengthError
  needs network.http
  purpose: Download a web page and return the number of characters in its title element.
  expose as tool

  let page be web.get(url) otherwise fail with DownloadFailed(url: url)
  let title be extract_title(page) otherwise fail with MissingTitle
  return title.length
end

function extract_title(page: Text) returns maybe Text
  let lowered be page.to_lower()
  let title_start be lowered.index_of("<title") otherwise return nothing
  let after_title_start be page.drop(title_start)
  let lowered_after_title_start be lowered.drop(title_start)
  let open_end be lowered_after_title_start.index_of(">") otherwise return nothing
  let content_start be title_start + open_end + 1
  let after_open_tag be page.drop(content_start)
  let lowered_after_open_tag be lowered.drop(content_start)
  let close_start be lowered_after_open_tag.index_of("</title>") otherwise return nothing
  return after_open_tag.take(close_start)
end
